title: Hendtheer Darbar
desc: After losing his position in a government office, Shivaramu, a miserly man, is compelled to seek employment in a politician's liquor business to satisfy his wife's financial needs.

title: Mikheal
desc: The police begin raising suspicions when members of two rival gangs are killed. However, further investigation points towards a doctor who is at the heart of a vicious revenge saga.

title: The Villain
desc: Ramu sets out to find his estranged brother, Rama, to reunite him with their mother. However, Ramu soon discovers that Rama is a mafia don, which makes it difficult for Ramu to approach his brother.

title: Bhairathi Ranagal
desc: Bhairathi Ranagal ends up in jail after going against the law. However, when he is released, he strives to fight for the people of his village.

title: Monsoon Raaga
desc: Four couples at different stages of their lives encounter love. In order to fully embrace it, they must overcome several limiting beliefs.
